parameters.content:
## What this does
Queries the warehouse for yesterday's funnel + spend numbers and posts a one-line summary to Slack #ops.

## Currently inactive
Slack workspace is not yet created (master plan §13 open question 1). When the workspace exists:
1. Create #ops channel
2. Add an incoming webhook (or n8n Slack node credential)
3. Update the SLACK_OPS_WEBHOOK env var on the n8n container
4. Flip `active` to true in this workflow

## KPI it affects
Leads at the funnel-top — keeps the team aware without flooding inboxes.

See UNDERWINGS-MASTER-PLAN.md §7/A + §7/B.

parameters.query:
WITH y AS (SELECT (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Dubai')::date - 1 AS d)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw.leads, y WHERE created_at::date = y.d) AS new_leads,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw.leads l, raw.lead_pipeline_stages s, y
     WHERE s.id = l.lead_pipeline_stage_id AND s.name IN ('MQL','Qualified','Requirements Gathered')
     AND l.updated_at::date = y.d) AS new_mqls,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw.leads l, raw.lead_pipeline_stages s, y
     WHERE s.id = l.lead_pipeline_stage_id AND s.name IN ('Discovery Booked','Demo Booked')
     AND l.updated_at::date = y.d) AS booked_calls,
  (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(cost_aed)::numeric, 2), 0) FROM ops.claude_api_calls, y
     WHERE called_at::date = y.d) AS claude_aed,
  (SELECT src.name FROM raw.leads l JOIN raw.lead_sources src ON src.id = l.lead_source_id, y
     WHERE l.created_at::date = y.d
     GROUP BY src.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS top_source;
